newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Res wins 29 Gulf of Mexico leases.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Res wins 29 Gulf of Mexico leases.

text.p: Burlington Resources said Friday it apparently was the highest bidder on 29 leases on a government bidding March 5 covering continental shelf and deepwater blocks in the central region of the Gulf of Mexico.
It said 11 of the leases were bid singly and 18 blocks with partners, it said.

If it is awarded the leases on which it was the apparent winner, the company would acquire 95,000 net acres to its offshore exploratory acreage position, it said. About half of the additions are deepwater areas, it said.
The bid was conducted by the Department of Interior under Outer Continental Shelf Lease Sale No. 166, it said.
